pages.text: Activated Fractionator: converts 1 activated crystal into 1 matching activated component and 1 exhausted crystal.$(br2)Each operation costs 2,000 energy and takes 100 ticks.$(br2)Components are the input of the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l).

$(bold)Exhausted crystals are retained:$(reset) entry reforging and item reconstruction both require them; this is covered in Secrets of Life.$(br2)Activated crystals themselves come from the exhausted-fuel activator and centrifuge route, also in Secrets of Life.
The chain overview is in $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l); components are sent to the $(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l).
